headline: Narendra Modi Inaugurates Bengaluru Metro Amidst Political Debates
seoTitle: Modi Launches Bengaluru Metro As Rahul Gandhi Alleges…
metaDescription: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurates the Bengaluru Metro Pink Line while facing renewed political challenges from Congress leader Rahul Gandhi.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the new elevated stretch of the Namma Metro Pink Line during his visit to Bengaluru.
The Prime Minister attended golden jubilee celebrations for Prashanti Kutiram and commemorated the birth centenary of H.V. Sheshadri.
Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi alleged his phone was being monitored and renewed his request for a direct debate with the Prime Minister.
aiContextParagraph: Prime Minister Narendra Modi conducted an official visit to Bengaluru to launch significant infrastructure projects, including the inauguration of the Namma Metro Pink Line. During his trip, he also participated in events honoring the legacy of former RSS general secretary H.V. Sheshadri and the golden jubilee of Prashanti Kutiram. Concurrently, political tension escalated as Congress leader Rahul Gandhi accused the administration of phone surveillance and issued a public challenge for a face-to-face debate with the Prime Minister. This allegation received support from Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav, while the Bharatiya Janata Party dismissed the claims. Further political discourse emerged following recent public interactions between the Prime Minister and figures like Sam Pitroda. The Prime Minister also remarked on his views regarding democracy during the visit, as political rhetoric between opposing parties continues to intensify across various platforms.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to the rapid pace of coverage across multiple national outlets, reflecting high political friction between the ruling party and the opposition.
